text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When viewed from the side,
the lower belly 
is not completely straight.
Even though it 
was perfectly aligned when measured
with a ruler.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Gaining weight is the archenemy of
speed. 
I must return to my ideal weight as soon 
as possible...!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, Trainer,
please help me 
with my diet!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list: Okay, don't let your abs slack! Ke...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list: Keep your core tight! Straight lin...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list: Why are you in a swimsuit?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's to show my progress to Trainer. I've 
even verified it with a ruler.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If I'm aiming to be the fastest,
it has to 
be this way after all.

Apparently, she was scolded afterward for 
walking the hallway in her swimsuit, but 
her weight was back to normal for now.
